abstract: |
  An introduction to the Open Problems in Single-Cell Analysis project, a community-driven effort to benchmark key computational challenges in single-cell data analysis.
  The presentation included an overview of the project, it's motivation how to get involved and an introduction to key technologies and concepts including [Viash](https://viash.io/), [Nextflow](https://www.nextflow.io/) and the Open Problems task structure.
  
  Presented at theMBZUAI 2025 Single Cell Summer Workshop.

  _This workshop was part of my involvement with Open Problems and my employment at Data Intuitive._
